title: Live catalog source readiness gate
privacyBoundary: External occurrence or distribution coordinates are raw/source-only metadata when a source license allows capture. They are not OverGarden user/product location data and must not enter canonical product projections, analytics, Meilisearch, logs, public pages, or UI without a later explicit ADR and SDD slice.

verdictLegend.USE: Current access and reuse basis are good enough for the named next ingestion slice, subject to attribution and field limits.
verdictLegend.USE-WITH-CONDITIONS: Technically reachable, but canonical product use is blocked until the listed legal, parser, license, or field-filter condition is satisfied.
verdictLegend.INTERNAL-VALIDATION-ONLY: May be used only to cross-check or validate internal decisions. Do not bulk ingest, redistribute, or expose in product projections.
verdictLegend.REJECT: Do not use for ingestion or validation without a new legal basis or explicit maintainer decision.

operatorSummary.nextSliceGate: OVE-56 may create raw/source snapshot quarantine only from USE sources. OVE-57, OVE-58, and OVE-60 may consume the explicitly named USE sources below. OVE-59, OVE-61, OVE-62, and marketplace/vendor paths must not promote conditional or internal-validation-only data until their blockers are closed.

sources.name: Ukraine State Register of Plant Varieties
sources.currentAccessPath: data.gov.ua dataset landing page plus exact resource URL for 2025-07-15_registervarietis.csv; use one-time resource fetch, not portal crawling.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Open-data CC-BY reuse with attribution; previous API_VERIFY_RESULTS captured the license basis and OVE-55 verified the actual CSV resource responds.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Official variety fields only. No user data. Proposed zone or distribution-like source fields remain source provenance unless a later projection deliberately maps them.
sources.sampleProof: Byte-range request returned HTTP 206 from 2025-07-15_registervarietis.csv. The file begins with variety schema fields and a public official row for Prunus armeniaca / Bergeron 1. The file is octet-stream UTF-16LE, so OVE-57 must decode explicitly.
knownBlockers: Confirm row count and full-file checksum inside raw/source quarantine before canonical projection.
Portal robots policy discourages automated crawling; fetch exact resource URLs or use an official channel.

liveChecks.notes: Landing proof only; it does not import the dataset.
Small range request only; proves rows without bulk import.

sources.name: Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank
sources.currentAccessPath: Catalogue of Life API release alias 3LR and ChecklistBank download/API surfaces.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Live API metadata reports license cc by for the current Catalogue of Life release.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Taxonomic names, ranks, synonyms, classification, identifiers, and source provenance. No occurrence coordinates in this backbone use.
sources.sampleProof: Live API dataset metadata returned alias COL26.6, license cc by, DOI 10.48580/dgy4k, and size 5,397,623; nameusage search returned Solanum lycopersicum.
knownBlockers: Carry attribution and release DOI/version into source provenance.
Do not treat vernacular coverage as sufficient for UA/BG; this is a species backbone source.

sources.name: World Flora Online Plant List
sources.currentAccessPath: WFO Zenodo community release metadata and downloadable dumps; avoid relying on unstable app hostnames for automation.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Zenodo metadata for the latest WFO community release reports license id cc-zero.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Plant taxonomic identifiers, scientific names, synonyms, ranks, and release provenance. No occurrence coordinates in this backbone use.
sources.sourceVersionOrDate: World Flora Online Plant List June 2026, publication_date 2026-06-21, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20782718
sources.sampleProof: Zenodo community metadata returned record 20782718 with CC0 license and files including plant_list_2026-06.sql.gz and plant_list_2026-06.json.zip.
knownBlockers: Large dump import belongs in OVE-56/OVE-58 raw-source quarantine, not in this gate.
Do not infer UA/BG vernacular coverage from WFO; use it as plant taxonomic backbone.

expectBodyIncludes: World Flora Online Plant List June 2026

sources.name: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
sources.currentAccessPath: GBIF public API and dataset metadata for the Backbone Taxonomy dataset.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for the backbone dataset; occurrence datasets have independent licenses and must be filtered separately.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Backbone dataset metadata reports CC-BY 4.0 legalcode. Occurrence records are not approved by this source entry unless row-level license is CC0/CC-BY.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Backbone taxonomy fields only by default. Occurrence/distribution coordinates, if used later from separate GBIF datasets, are raw/source-only and require CC0/CC-BY filtering.
sources.sourceVersionOrDate: GBIF Backbone dataset DOI 10.15468/39omei, pubDate 2023-08-28, modified 2023-11-17
sources.sampleProof: Dataset metadata returned title GBIF Backbone Taxonomy, CC-BY 4.0 license, and DOI 10.15468/39omei. Species match returned usageKey 2930137 for Solanum lycopersicum.
knownBlockers: Do not ingest occurrence coordinates into product projections.
Filter non-commercial occurrence datasets if a later slice uses occurrence data at all.

sources.name: EPPO Codes and Global Database
sources.currentAccessPath: EPPO Data Services landing page, Open Licence PDF, and Global Database taxon pages.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Research corpus recorded explicit commercial-use wording; OVE-55 live checks confirm the current Open Data Licence surface and taxon pages remain reachable.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: EPPO code, scientific names, synonyms, common names, regulated-organism metadata, and source provenance. Distribution fields are raw/source-only unless a later safe aggregate projection is approved.
sources.sourceVersionOrDate: Live access verified 2026-06-29; EPPO taxon page for SOLLC reachable
sources.sampleProof: data.eppo.int returned Open Data Licence references. gd.eppo.int/taxon/SOLLC returned a live taxon page for Solanum laciniatum (SOLLC).
knownBlockers: Attribution is mandatory.
Measure UA/BG common-name coverage before relying on EPPO as a vernacular source.
Do not project distribution data into product UI/search in v0.

liveChecks.notes: Checks the named licence document exists without downloading it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.currentAccessPath: Wikidata EntityData JSON and SPARQL/dumps for later bounded extraction.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Wikidata entity data is CC0. OVE-55 uses it only as supplemental alias/entity evidence, never as sole canonical truth.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Entity IDs, labels, aliases, taxon/cultivar claims, and source references. Ignore properties unrelated to catalog identity.
sources.sampleProof: EntityData JSON for Q23501 returned a live JSON entity payload.
knownBlockers: Coverage is uneven; use as supplement only.
Filter claims to catalog identity fields and carry Wikidata QID provenance.

sources.name: USDA GRIN-Global Taxonomy
sources.currentAccessPath: GRIN-Global public taxonomy web surface; later implementation should use official dumps or documented export path, not scrape interactive pages.
sources.license: US public-domain compatible federal data, with source-specific confirmation required for any non-US contributed records.
sources.commercialUseBasis: Research corpus classifies USDA GRIN as public domain; OVE-55 verifies the current official taxonomy search surface is reachable.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Taxonomy, economic-plant common names, synonyms, source IDs, and provenance. No product location.
sources.sampleProof: GRIN-Global taxonomy search page returned live HTML containing Search Taxonomy Data in GRIN-Global.
knownBlockers: No modern public REST endpoint was approved by this gate; use official dump/export path in raw quarantine.
Confirm licensing on any non-US contributed subset before canonical projection.

liveChecks.notes: Reachability proof only; no page scraping approved.

sources.name: Vertebrate Breed Ontology
sources.currentAccessPath: OBO/OLS ontology metadata and PURL downloads for vertebrate breed backbone.
sources.commercialUseBasis: OVE-55 live OLS metadata confirms VBO is reachable; previous API_VERIFY_RESULTS confirmed CC-BY and version 2026-04-15.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: VBO IDs, English labels, romanized synonyms, NCBITaxon alignment, DAD-IS alignment metadata, and provenance.
sources.sourceVersionOrDate: OLS reports VBO loaded 2026-04-15 with languages [en]
sources.sampleProof: OLS API returned ontologyId vbo and languages [en]. This reconfirms no UA/BG labels and no bee coverage; VBO is a vertebrate backbone only.
knownBlockers: Not a localized UA/BG label source.
Does not cover bees/Apis; bee identities must use the small official/manual path.

sources.name: IASAS BG Official Variety List
sources.license: Reuse basis not explicit enough for automatic commercial projection
sources.commercialUseBasis: Technically reachable official list, but OVE-55 does not find a clean machine-readable export or explicit commercial reuse grant.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Official variety-list fields extracted from PDF/HTML only after parser proof and attribution. No user data.
sources.sampleProof: IASAS official-variety-list page returned HTTP 200 and contains OSL references.
knownBlockers: PDF/HTML only; no approved API/CSV.
Commercial reuse basis must be captured from IASAS or legal review before canonical product projection.
Parser/OCR proof belongs in OVE-61.

liveChecks.notes: Reachability proof only; not permission proof.

sources.sampleProof: EU Plant Variety Portal returned live application HTML containing Plant Variety Portal references.

sources.name: Encyclopedia of Life vernacular names
sources.currentAccessPath: Zenodo vernacular dump metadata is reachable; HTML docs may block automated checks.
sources.license: Mixed or not specified at the dump metadata level; row-level licensing must be resolved before product use
sources.commercialUseBasis: Not approved for canonical projection until non-commercial rows are excluded and source license is machine-recorded.
sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Vernacular names, taxon IDs, language, provider, preference flags, and per-row/provider license only after a license-filter pipeline exists.
sources.sampleProof: Zenodo API returned Vernacular names: vernacular names, May 2020, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13223288, but license id is notspecified.
knownBlockers: License is not specified at metadata level.
Must filter or reject non-commercial and share-alike rows before any canonical/public projection.
Do not rely on EOL as sole UA/BG alias source.

sources.name: iNaturalist taxa and vernacular names
sources.license: API/content terms and per-field/per-media licenses require filtering; not treated as clean canonical source by OVE-55

sources.allowedSensitiveFields: Taxon names and vernacular names only after license/terms filtering. Do not ingest observations, users, photos, or coordinates for product projection.
sources.sampleProof: Taxa API returned total_results for Solanum lycopersicum.
knownBlockers: Do not ingest observation/user/photo data.
License/terms filtering needed before alias projection.
BG vernacular coverage is expected to be weak.
